uncited: It builds on [Sparse View and Few-Shot Optimization](14428-sparse-view-and-few-shot-optimization.md) by actively expanding the training dataset rather than relying solely on implicit regularization.

The method alternates between training a coarse scene representation, generating pseudo-observations guided by an uncertainty measure, and retraining the representation on the combined set of real and pseudo-observations.
This cycle is repeated to progressively densify the input views.
Uses an MLP-based NeRF (Nerfacto) as the backbone.
Suitable for scenes where volumetric representation is preferred or when integrating with existing NeRF pipelines. [Link](7371-simple-nerf.md)
Uses 3D Gaussian Splatting (Splatfacto) as the backbone.
Suitable for real-time rendering requirements and scenes with complex geometry where Gaussian primitives excel. [Link](14428-sparse-view-and-few-shot-optimization.md)
*   **Memory Complexity:** Not given in the sources.
